title: Erebus Wiki
tagline: The lore and chronicle encyclopedia for the Athens Through Time Vampire role play universe.
description: A specialized encyclopedia and knowledge base for Athens Through Time players and Storytellers. Articles document Kindred histories, clan lineages, Elysium locations, and city politics with full revision tracking and rollback. Features include an interactive force directed lore relationship graph with React Flow, historical timelines, collaborative corkboards, and private player journals.
highlights: Markdown article editor with version history, rollback, and infoboxes
Interactive force directed lore graph powered by React Flow
Chronicle history timeline and collaborative corkboard pinboards
Full text search across articles and personal player journals
